با هر بار باز کردن برنامه رمز را وارد می: You enter the password every time the app opens. The key to all data (settings, database, backups, logs and secrets) is opened only with the password and never stored; without the password even a modified build of the app sees nothing. No automation runs until the password is entered. The most secure mode.
کلید با Windows DPAPI روی همین کاربر وین: The key is protected with Windows DPAPI for this Windows user. A copied file cannot be opened elsewhere, but any program running as this user (even a modified build of AutoKRP) can open all data.
هشدار: با «باز شدن خودکار» کلید با DPAPI: Warning: with “Open automatically” the key stays on disk with DPAPI for this Windows user and the master password no longer really protects anything: any program running as this user, including a malicious or modified build of AutoKRP, opens all data and secrets without the password. Turn it on only if automation after a restart is required and you trust this computer and Windows user.
هشدار: با روشن بودن این گزینه، هر برنامه: Warning: while this is on, any program that runs on this server, including a malicious or modified build of AutoKRP that someone puts in place of the app, opens all data, tokens and device passwords without any password and can use them to connect to FortiGate, Splunk, Redmine and the devices. If insider sabotage or other people's access to this server is a risk, do not turn it on. Without this option, no data can be opened without a user's password.
